'''B3-3P5''' was a [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]] that was often used to assist [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
B3-3P5's name resembles the word "Beeps." This is likely a pun, a reference to [[Binary/Legends|Droidspeak]].
